prenderei.en: I would take; I would take

texto: **Condición con SE**: congiuntive imfect (**Se abitassi**, **Se studiassi**).

Look at the examples: **Se abitassi a Roma, prenderei la metro** (if I lived in Rome, I would take the subway); **Se studiassi di più, capiresti meglio** (if you studied more, you would understand better).

filas: If I lived in the middle, I'd take the subway.
If you studied with method, you would understand the concepts.
If I had a bike, I'd move faster.

bloques.titulo: It's going to be in the center.

frases.it: Se abitassi in centro a Milano, prenderei la metropolitana ogni mattina.
frases.es: Si viviera en el centro en Milán, cogería el metro cada mañana.
frases.en: If I lived downtown in Milan, I'd take the subway every morning.
analisis: if I lived in the center

frases.it: E se studiassi più vicino a casa, risparmieresti molto tempo!
frases.es: ¡Y si estudiaras más cerca de casa, ahorrarías mucho tiempo!
frases.en: And if you studied closer to home, you'd save a lot of time!
analisis: You'd save a lot of time.

frases.it: È vero. Se avessi una bicicletta, mi muoverei ancora più velocemente.
frases.es: Es verdad. Si tuviera una bicicleta, me movería todavía más rápido.
frases.en: It's true. If I had a bike, I'd move even faster.

bloques.pregunta: In the «Se abitassi a Roma, prenderei la metro» phrase, why is «prenderei» on parole?

opciones.texto: Because it is the hypothetical consequence that would result if the condition of living in Rome was met.
opciones.explicacion: The apodosis of the hypothetical type II period requires a conditional present.

opciones.texto: Because the verb «prendere» must be conditional on public transport.
opciones.explicacion: It responds to the logical structure of the conditional period, not to the means of transport.

opciones.texto: Because he describes a routine of the past that was repeated every morning.

bloques.frase: Se tu studiassi con più calma, ___ molto meglio le spiegazioni.

opciones.explicacion: Second singular person from «capire»'s present conditional.
It is present as an informal indication.
It is congiuntive imperfect (it cannot go in consequence).

bloques.frase: Se avessi una bicicletta, mi muoverei ancora più velocemente.

opciones.texto: A desirable improvement in mobility conditional on having a two-wheel vehicle.
opciones.explicacion: Ecstasy with «avessi» and apodosis with «mi muoverei» in reflective conditional.

opciones.texto: That the speaker already has three bicycles and travels by train daily.
opciones.explicacion: It expresses the current lack of bicycle using «se avessi».

opciones.texto: That the traffic of the city is so fluid that there is no need for any transport.
opciones.explicacion: Search for quick alternatives to move better.

bloques.frase: Se abitassi vicino all'università prenderei la metropolitana ogni giorno
bloques.traduccion: If I lived near the university I'd take the subway every day.
bloques.explicacion: Second-degree hypothetical period with a classic order of prosectics and apodosis.

bloques.pregunta: What syntactic error does the «Se studierei, capirei» phrase contain?

opciones.texto: The abuse of the conditional after the conditional combination «se».
opciones.explicacion: After «se» it is never placed conditional in Italian; it should be said «se studiassi».

opciones.texto: La falta de concordancia en género femenino con el adjetivo posterior.
opciones.explicacion: It's a verbal-mode selection error in prosectics.

opciones.texto: The absence of an articulated preposition before the verb.
opciones.explicacion: The conjugated verbs have no articulated preposition in front.

bloques.frase: Se noi avessimo una macchina, ___ a trovare i nonni ogni domenica.

opciones.explicacion: First plural person from «andare»'s present conditional.

bloques.pregunta: What is the exact meaning of this statement?
bloques.frase: Se studiassi di più, capiresti meglio.

opciones.texto: If you studied more, you'd understand better.
opciones.explicacion: Type II period which kindly suggests an improvement in performance.

opciones.texto: Since you didn't study anything yesterday, you suspended the test.
opciones.explicacion: It embodies the present situation as a constructive council, not as a reproach passed.

opciones.texto: You study a lot, and that's why you understand everything perfectly.
opciones.explicacion: He suggested that the interlocutor was not currently studying enough.

intro: The consequence of a second-degree hypothesis should always be formulated on a conditional basis. Never make the mistake of repeating the congiuntive or placing the conditional in the condition.
